reaction: The explanation helped connect the supporting material to the muscle's pull.

reason: The rear tendons are the only offered combination and should form the opposing muscle group.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen was most worthwhile because it connected fuel and cellular ATP production to the muscle's continuing work.
